Delete your DressYou account

DressYou is operated by [[FOUNDER: operator-identity — the company's legal name, legal form, registered address and registration number]]. This page says how to delete an account, what is erased and what stays. People who cannot open the app can ask by email.

In the app

On iPhone:

  1. Open DressYou and sign in.
  2. Open the tab that shows your photo or initial, then the menu at the top right.
  3. Under “privacy & safety”, choose “delete account”.
  4. Enter your password, or confirm with Apple if the account was created with Apple, then confirm in the dialog.

[[FOUNDER: deletion-steps — confirm on a phone before launch: the iPhone steps above as written, and the Android steps with their own labels (AR4), including the Google confirmation if Google sign-in ships (AR16); then replace this marker with the Android steps]]

What deletion erases

DressYou deletes the account and everything it holds, all at once and for good: body data and measurements, photographs, wardrobe, outfits and saves, fit answers and style rules, and every linked browser. The photographs are then erased from storage.

[[FOUNDER: deletion-and-subscription — Does deleting the account cancel a running store subscription, and what is the person told before deletion?]]

What stays, and for how long

Some data outlasts the deletion for a time. The privacy notice, section 6, gives every period. What stays, as it says:

  • database backups: 35 days; erased data stays in a backup until the backup ages out; if the database itself is ever deleted, a final snapshot is kept with no set expiry [[COUNSEL: backup-replay — Are 35 days of backups holding erased data acceptable, with erasures replayed after any restore, and is a final snapshot with no set expiry acceptable? Counsel brief A5(3).]]
  • copies held by the image provider: up to 30 days; until shorter retention is granted, deleting data in DressYou does not delete those copies (section 2.3) [[FOUNDER: openai-terms — Are OpenAI's European residency and modified retention granted and signed before launch?]]
  • application logs: 30 days, without tokens, signed links or request contents
  • records of image-provider calls: kept; on account deletion the link to the account is removed [[COUNSEL: ledger-after-erasure — Once the account is erased, is a record that keeps the provider's request identifier still personal data, and how long may cost records be kept? Counsel brief C2.]]
  • records of what you bought from DressYou, the paid tier and renders: [[COUNSEL: purchase-records-retention — How long must purchase and billing records be kept under French accounting and tax rules?]]
  • reports, notices, decisions and appeals: [[FOUNDER: moderation-retention — how long reports, notices, decisions, statements of reasons and appeals are kept]]; when a reporter’s account is deleted, the report loses its link to that account and the decision remains [[COUNSEL: lcen-retention — Does the French decree on hosts' retention of contributor data oblige DressYou to keep data identifying the authors of posts, comments and votes, and for how long? Counsel brief B15.]]

Copies that others kept or shared outside DressYou, and files exported before the deletion, cannot be recalled.

Without the app

To ask for deletion without being able to open the app, write to [[FOUNDER: privacy-contact — the address that receives privacy questions and rights requests]], giving the email address of the account and saying that the request is to delete the account. DressYou answers within one month; for a complex request the period can be extended by two more months, and DressYou says why within the first month.
